items.title: Eddie Palmieri — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: a gentleman named Joseph Palmieri, in (?—6:38) Aurora, used to take the Italians from Italy—Corsica, excuse me—to Puerto Rico and then back.

ctx.x: Do you know why the two brothers originally left Corsica?

No. But they were very wealthy. Maybe that was the reason. They had like the gold inlays and... It was amazing, the stories that we’ve heard. And Amelia, the oldest daughter, was Harold Graham’s mother. What a coincidence, right? Amazing story. Then I met another Palmieri with my wife in Colombia, and he looked...you could tell he was a Palmieri. Could have been the ship that was lost in the high seas. But that brings the name of Palmieri, and... There’s a place in Puerto Rico called Yauco, which is a little up…
So is it accurate to say that your parents before leaving, or maybe at least your father before leaving Puerto Rico, was well-off?
